name: Spellfire Storm

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Create a 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high brightly lit Cylinder. Appearance, first entry on a turn, or end of turn prompts Constitution against 4d10 Radiant (half on success), once per turn. Spellcasting inside also requires Constitution: failure wastes the casting action but no spell slot. Designate exempt creatures on casting. Add 1d10 damage per slot above 4. Circle variant consumes a 25,000 GP blue star sapphire; range 1 mile, no Concentration, each secondary caster spends a level 3+ slot. With 1–3/4–6/7+ secondary casters, radius and height are 40/60/100 feet and duration is 1/8/24 hours. Ends if any participant joins another Circle casting of Spellfire Storm.
